title: List files in a directory
summary: Show the contents of the current directory or a specific path. You can choose to see hidden files, detailed information like size and permissions, or sort by time or size.

steps.explain: List files in the current directory, one per line.

alternatives.explain: List all files, including hidden ones (those starting with a dot).
List files in long format with human-readable sizes (KB, MB, GB).

steps.explain: To list a specific directory, add the path. Use placeholders for your specific folder.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: Path to the directory you want to list
